facts.value: Callback records flow from the global registry into callback invocation, and each returned linked item enters one of three rendering paths. Shared row and column accumulators carry layout state across callbacks and item chains.

facts.value: Composes registered developer-diagnostic producers into one immediate-mode overlay. It invokes every reachable callback in the global registry, traverses each returned display-item chain, lays items out in a 60-column display, and renders text, color gradients, and proportional ticked bars with optional dark backing rectangles.
facts.rationale: The current implementation begins from the global registry, invokes each producer, traverses its returned items, maintains shared layout coordinates, and dispatches the three supported item forms to drawing helpers.

evidence.why: Shows the callback and item traversals, layout state, optional backing rectangles, and text, gradient, and bar drawing paths.

facts.value: Each invocation starts at column 60 with line coordinate 1.0 and a one-shot first-item flag. The first encountered item may create the initial dark backing row. Text wraps when its visible width would exceed column 60, decrementing the line and resetting the column, then advances the column by visible width plus two. A gradient or any nonempty bar sequence moves to a half-line boundary when needed, occupies a 600-unit row, and leaves the column at 60. Empty bar sequences draw nothing, while null callback results and an empty registry are skipped by the nested traversal guards.
facts.rationale: The current initialization, first-item guard, text-width comparison, half-line adjustments, positive bar-total guard, and nullable traversals preserve these exact layout transitions and suppression cases.

evidence.why: Shows layout initialization, first-item handling, text wrapping and advancement, half-line transitions, bar suppression, and nullable traversals.
